name: Checkbook Balancer
meta_title: Checkbook Balancer: Reconcile Your Bank Statement
meta_description: Balance your checkbook: enter your statement balance, outstanding checks and deposits in transit, and compare with your register to find the difference.
subtitle: Reconcile your checking account: adjust the bank statement for checks and deposits that haven’t cleared, compare it with your register, and see whether the two match.
